_about: Player settings (see Settings and the settings screen, opened with Escape or Start). These are the defaults for a new install; what players pick is kept in user://settings.json, apart from the save. Volumes are 0-1 (0 is silent) and go through the Master, Music and SFX audio buses. Cursor speeds multiply how fast the close-up cursor moves: on a gamepad (CookSession.pad_cursor_speed) and on the keys (cursor_speed). hybrid_camera: with two players, views join into one when the chefs are close (off: always side by side). guide_always: the Guide's arrow every day (off: on the first day and for chefs on their first shift). two_on_keyboard: two players can share the keyboard, one on WASD + E and one on the arrows + Enter (off: nobody joins on the arrows, and a keyboard player can use either set of keys).
